description: MIKE+Py is DHI's Python interface for working with MIKE+ model databases. It opens SQLite projects, exposes tables through Pandas, manages scenarios and alternatives, and starts simulations for documented CS, EPANET and SWMM modules. Inputs are existing model databases and scripted changes; outputs are updated scenarios, tables and solver results. Coverage is global and follows the configured MIKE+ project, including its spatial resolution and simulation period. Public wrapper code and pip installation are free under Apache-2.0, but use requires a valid MIKE+ licence. A limitation is that changes directly modify the database without an undo function, so the provider advises working on copies. The README also documents import-order conflicts with other DHI libraries and release-year version matching. The package supports repeatable scenario preparation around the catalogue's MIKE+ platform (platform-dhi-mike-plus). It is an independently released automation interface, not an additional hydraulic engine. No model database was opened or changed during this review.
